articles.title: 76ers' LeBron James to sit vs. Bucks in first game of back-to-back
articles.summary: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.

articles.title: Jazz add former lottery pick
